verdict.rationale: Bevy documents official support for Windows, MacOS, Linux, Web, iOS, and Android (bevy-docs-6, bevy-docs-31), and community feedback corroborates real mobile/web usage (bevy-comm-11, bevy-comm-20), covering desktop and mobile well. However, there is no evidence anywhere in the pack of console export capability, either direct or via third-party partners, which is a core part of this story. Missing for 10: any documentation or community evidence of console (Xbox/PlayStation/Switch) export paths, partner porting programs, or console SDK integration.
